gen-gf-sniglet-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans reads friendly and open, its c an easy arc. Sniglet is the showier one, a single-width line with stubby terminals that makes a heading stand out, while the sans just gets on with the sentences.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-quattrocento-sans: Modern and tidy, Quattrocento Sans keeps its c clearly apart from an o, which helps text stay legible. And Sniglet, drawn like a plotter pen with one line weight, takes the attention up top while the plain sans lets the paragraphs follow.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-red-hat-text: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in, giving every heading a blunt, quiet beat. And Red Hat Text brings the fine, technical-pen line and loose curves that make the sans-serif feel relaxed beneath it.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-reddit-sans: Sniglet's terminals stop short of curling back in, which gives its display letters a level, unshowy push. But Reddit Sans does the steady reading work, its e wide at the mouth and its strokes uniform in thickness in every direction.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-rethink-sans: Sniglet's blunt, level display letters hit first, with none of the usual weight accents, and Rethink Sans lets generous openings follow. Contrast between them is the draw.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-roboto-flex: Roboto Flex starts things off with a wide slot in its c. Sniglet is the better show-off, its wire-like line holding firm through every curve, whereas the plain sans does its best work as the approachable, modern text underneath.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-rosario: Approachable from the first word, Rosario never turns the ends of its c inward. But Sniglet is the louder one, its curves keeping full thickness at every turn, while the sans simply carries the sentences.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ruluko: Sniglet draws its headings with a thickness that holds steady around every curve, stubby terminals included. Ruluko then lays out broad open counters on c and s, and the plain sans keeps the text approachable.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-sansation: Sniglet's stroke weight never varies, so each heading looks bent from one line. But Sansation brings softer, approachable curves with no ink pooling at the turns, and the plain sans makes a quiet partner.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-sarabun: Sarabun reads clean and approachable, with a wide channel into every bowl. Sniglet, with its wire-bent sign look, handles the headings, so Sarabun can be sized up a touch for comfort.
